:::{#exm-percent}
#### Ten percent is one tenth

Contrary to what you may have learned previously,
the equality $10\% = 0.1$ is true and correct,
just as $10 \text{kg} = 10,000 \text{g}$ is true and correct:

$$
\ba
10\% &= \frac{10}{100}
&& \text{(definition of percent)}
\\ &= 0.1
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

:::
